タイトル: The reporting finally tells me what my properties are actually earning
投稿者: Marcelo イタリアのManager ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The reporting finally tells me what my properties are actually earning"
良い点: Before Lodgify, my revenue reporting was a monthly nightmare — three platforms, three different dashboards, manual copy-paste into a spreadsheet. Now every booking, payout and fee flows into Lodgify's reports automatically. I can see occupancy, average daily rate and revenue per property over any period in seconds. The monthly summary has become the most reliable business document I have. My conversations with my accountant are now half the length they used to be — they get clean, consistent numbers without me having to prepare anything separately.
改善点: I'd love side-by-side property comparisons over custom date ranges. For instance, RevPAR plotted across all four properties in a single view. The current reporting is solid — it just leaves me wanting a bit more analytical depth.

タイトル: My guests let themselves in at 2 am without waking me up anymore.
投稿者: Stanislav スペインのOwner ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "My guests let themselves in at 2 am without waking me up anymore."
良い点: The smart lock integration has been the most lifestyle-changing feature I've found. Every reservation automatically generates a unique access code, sends it to the guest before arrival, and expires it after checkout. I haven't met a guest at the door in over 8 months.
改善点: The initial setup with one of my lock brands took a couple of attempts and some back-and-forth with their support team.

タイトル: Cross mapped our properties, sent a guest into an occupied unit
投稿者: Mohammed アメリカのOwner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Cross mapped our properties, sent a guest into an occupied unit"
良い点: The interface is clean and easy to navigate, and the website builder is decent. Setting up listings and templates is straightforward. Those are genuinely the only positives I can point to after using the platform.
改善点: We manage short term rentals across Airbnb, Vrbo, and Booking.com. Our Vrbo integration was not activated for weeks after onboarding, which caused double bookings. When it went live, our two properties were cross mapped to the wrong Vrbo listings, so every Vrbo reservation landed on the wrong unit. Because the correct unit's calendar never blocked, a guest walked into an occupied condo at 10 PM on another guest. That resulted in a refund, cancelled reservations, channel penalties, a restricted Vrbo listing, and legal threats. Support replied slowly, told us the mapping was a self service process, and stated there was no indication of financial loss while we were refunding money and cancelling bookings.

タイトル: The calendar sync finally gave me peace of mind
投稿者: Misha スペインのSelf-employed 認証済みLinkedInユーザー レジャー、旅行、観光, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The calendar sync finally gave me peace of mind"
良い点: The channel manager is the reason I stayed. My Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com calendars now update in real time through direct API connections, not iCal. Before Lodgify I had two double bookings in my first year of hosting. Since switching, zero. The unified calendar view means I can see every reservation across every channel in one place, and adjusting availability only takes one click instead of logging into three separate extranets.
改善点: I'd love more granular channel-specific rate rules — for example, different cancellation policies per platform within the same rate plan. It's workable as is, but more flexibility would help.

タイトル: Scaling Your Direct Bookings with Lodgify
投稿者: Jocelyn アメリカのDigital Marketing Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Scaling Your Direct Bookings with Lodgify"
良い点: The Direct Booking Engine: This is Lodgify's "bread and butter." The website builder is incredibly intuitive, allowing you to create a professional-looking site that actually converts. It's a game-changer for avoiding high OTA (Online Travel Agency) fees and building a direct relationship with guests. Seamless Channel Management: The calendar synchronization is robust. It centralizes bookings from Airbnb, VRBO, and Booking.com effectively, which is crucial for preventing the nightmare of double bookings. Onboarding & Support: Unlike many tech platforms, Lodgify’s onboarding process is highly personalized. Having a dedicated specialist walk you through the setup especially when mapping different channels shortens the learning curve significantly.
改善点: Website Customization Limits: While the website builder is easy to use, it does have its "ceilings." If you want a highly unique or complex design, the templates can feel a bit restrictive.

タイトル: Great Support and Clean UI, After a Rough Onboarding
投稿者: Julio グアテマラのOwner 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great Support and Clean UI, After a Rough Onboarding"

改善点: Some of the workflows for the website and listings feel unintuitive. For example, I sometimes have to publish changes and then go back into the backend to undo or adjust things for them to properly reflect across platforms. It’s a bit of a workaround—odd, but it does work.

タイトル: Best way to setup a direct holiday rental website
投稿者: Nigel 英国のRetired property owner ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Best way to setup a direct holiday rental website"
良い点: With Lodgify I was able to make a professional direct booking website for our gite in France. It synchs calendar availability with Airbnb and Booking.com. Very easy to use and I had my website ready to use within the trial period, making this a zero risk purchase decision. Lodgify made it easy to integrate with a secure payment processing service (Stripe). We use the automated price optimisation facility which gives me a lot of confidence that we are maximising both our daily price and occupancy. The AI help system is REMARKABLE! Virtually all questions I have had were quickly solved. And when I needed human tech support that has been quick and super helpful. Probably the best customer service I’ve ever had from a software company. Help articles on subjects like SEO have helped me further improve performance. Our property now ranks top for our main search criteria and we have direct bookings via Google maps.
改善点: Integration with Vrbo was too difficult. But that has since been solved and in truth the technical problems were the fault of Vrbo whose technology stack is a hodgepodge of old systems held together with sticky tape, the result of years of acquisitions and cobbled together integration.

投稿者: Matt アメリカのOwner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Lodgify - recommended"
良い点: I have been using Lodgify (Pro) over the last year I have found it to be very useful in managing my two listings across Booking, VRBO, and Airbnb. Additionally, the website builder was also very easy to use and set up. The security of the site seems fairly standard with a 2FA option that I use. Customer support is very helpful with the option to chat or call, and the onboarding process was individualized. Payment for the platform is again fairly standard with the options to pay by month or by the year and the payments are auto drafted. All in all, I have found the platform to be a fair value for the money.
改善点: I have noted a couple of bugs in some of the reporting tools that come with the Pro level subscription. most notably, when Lodgify records the number of nights book they are actually reporting on the number of days booked. This is def not the industry standard as we charge per night in most cases. I have reported the issue months back and it has not be corrected. This particular bug has a downstream effect on other reports such as ADR as well as others. One feature Lodgify does not support and I hope it does soon is the ability to include short videos to the website. This is particularly useful for property walkthroughs and for compelling landing pages.

タイトル: Un B&B anarchico: si gestisce completamente da solo. (grazie a Lodgify)

良い点: Con Lodgify posso differenziare i prezzi per ogni OTA. Tutti i processi sono (dopo il settaggio avvenuto tramite l'omboarding gratuito offerto da personale molto esperto e molto paziente di Lodgify) completamente automatizzati. Gli Ospiti fanno in totale autonomia l'online check-in, quindi ricevono automaticamente la password e le istruzioni per entrare in casa. Inoltre ricevono mappe e una APP personalizzata per gli Ospiti con tutte le INFO sul B&B (wifi, istruzioni per arrivare, self check-out). Il sistema mi informa se devo intervenire manualmente (ma succede assai raramente perché se gli Ospiti non sono solerti vengono sollecitati da mail, messaggi tramite chat (nella chat dell'OTA che l'Ospite sta utilizzando) e pure via SMS automatici e gratuiti. Le sincronizzazioni sono istantanee quindi è impossibile un overbooking. E il costo comprende anche un bellissimo sito internet del B&B, dove si ricevono prenotazioni senza le commissioni degli OTA. I competitors fanno pagare il sito web a parte, mentre Lodgify no.
改善点: Se si vogliono usare tutte le funzioni, allora all'inizio c'è da lavorare un pochettino. Anche se il 90% lo si fa in video chiamata con un Agente di Lodgify, gratuitamente. A me la Signora Alessia ha fornito due lunghe videochiamate, dove mi chiedeva come volessi i settaggi e lei li faceva al posto mio. Inoltre mi ha spiegato tutte le funzioni e ha fatto le connessioni con gli OTA e con CheKin per la consegna delle chiavi virtuali agli Ospiti e la registrazione delle schede (invio alla Polizia e all'Istat). Insomma non devo fare più nulla. L'unico svantaggio è che essendo io molto poco tecnologico sono stato in ballo diversi giorni. Ma poi ne è valsa la pena. ora non devo fare più NULLA!!! (mentre prima passavo 3 ore al giorno al PC)

タイトル: Poor customer service, poor website builder, broken implementation process, would not recommend!
投稿者: Ben アメリカのProperty Manager 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Poor customer service, poor website builder, broken implementation process, would not recommend!"
良い点: The website builder was the main reason why we wanted to go forward with this software. Although we never got the chance to integrate it in to our own website, the thought of being able to replicate VRBO or Airbnb on our own website without paying the royalties would have been a huge benefit. The API connection process with PriceLabs was very simple. Took about five minutes.
改善点: Integration process: This was the most difficult software integration I have ever experienced. Between the 5-8 day leeway in customer service response and the hoops you have to jump, be prepared to go for a very frustrating ride. I subscribed to Lodgify, then it took nearly two weeks to go live with VRBO because of their process. Once my listing finally went live, my booked calendar was partially deleted without notice, allowing guests to create bookings during times that were not available. I had 4 bookings created during times that were unavailable, all within 30 minutes. Customer service was unresponsive, it took 5 days for them to respond after calling (went straight to voicemail, yes they have voicemail) and by email. Set up: The process to set up the system was very awkward. You not only had to build the listing in VRBO, you also had to directly replicate the listing in Lodgify. I then later found out that Lodgify, due to how the systems communicate with each other, Lodgify supersedes any communication from VRBO. Therefore, most of my information on my listing was deleted. ***Very important point to note: Lodgify DOES NOT read the calendar off of VRBO. If a guest is interested in your property, they inquire on a date, VRBO then checks Lodgify to see if the dates are available, and then responds back that the dates are unavailable, then confusing the guest. I have had dozens of guests message me about dates that were unavailable and were confused and frustrated.

タイトル: From Lukewarm to Fan and Back to Luke Warm
投稿者: Joanna アメリカのCEO ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "From Lukewarm to Fan and Back to Luke Warm"
良い点: My experience with lodgify started off very rocky. I wasn't happy with the features, experienced many crashes of the site in the first year that were very frustrating, and there were a few features that were broken entirely. Initially, I had the impression that they didn't have any intention of improving their software. Now that I've been using lodgify for a year and a half there are many broken features that are now working. The coupon codes actually work on mobile now which is something we had contacted them about at least a dozen times. Customer service responds quickly though there are delays because they are in Spain. There can also be some communication issues. We are a long established company with a well recognized brand that has always taken bookings off of our website, for years before switching to lodgify. This is why the platforms functionality was even more important to us. We have over a dozen properties and do around half a million in revenue a year.
改善点: Lodgify isn't exactly honest when you are signing up. We were told that if we signed up for the yearly subscription of $1,100 that we would be locked into that price for life. Well, just two years later and they raised the price $472.00 and told us that they would not be honoring their promised of their lifetime locked in price. They said that their website had been much improved since we signed up and used that as the reason for their price hike. Honestly though, nothing has changed on their website aside from a few broken features actually being fixed. They also charge $1,200 a year to integrate to stripe, so just to use lodgify you are looking at use shy of 3 grand if you have less than 15 properties. That on top of the 2.9% processing fees you are already paying with stripe. Our biggest disappointment with Lodgify came about a month ago when they decided to publish a blog that they sent to all of their email subscribers. In their blog they used our business and claimed our success was due to building a website with lodgify---a tall claim considering we only use their reservation system and we were a nationally recognized brand long before we ever adopted their software. In the blog they linked to our website, used our copyrighted photos without permission, and encouraged others to copy our very unique business model. In conclusion: Not a lot of integrity with lodgify in our experience. We like the reservation system but there is still room for improvement.

タイトル: Disappointing Experience for Australian Businesses We initially chose Lodgify for our Australian business
投稿者: Ali オーストラリアのOwner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Disappointing Experience for Australian Businesses We initially chose Lodgify for our Australian business"
良い点: Onboarding easy but once live we realised it did not do what it needed to do for our business so basically we have paid for a year for something we can't use.
改善点: Disappointing Experience for Australian Businesses We initially chose Lodgify for our Australian business, believing it to be the best option available. The onboarding process was smooth, and we were optimistic about going live. However, during the final session, a critical issue arose - Lodgify was unable to generate invoices with our ABN, a requirement for Australian businesses like ours. This revelation in the final onboarding meeting was a deal-breaker. Lodgify's inability to meet our invoicing needs rendered the platform unsuitable for our operations. Despite the fact that it took longer than 14 days to set up the account, Lodgify adamantly refused to provide any refund for the upfront payment we made for a full year of service. For Australian businesses looking for a comprehensive solution, Lodgify's insistence on using a third-party app for invoicing undermines the concept of a one-stop shop. Our experience with Lodgify has been a costly mistake, with over $2000 wasted. We caution other Australian businesses to steer clear of this software to avoid similar frustrations. In conclusion, Lodgify's failure to address basic invoicing requirements for Australian businesses makes it an impractical choice for those seeking a seamless and integrated solution

タイトル: Super Allround-Lösung zur Selbstvermarktung unseres Ferienhauses
投稿者: Frank ドイツのManager レクリエーション施設・サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Super Allround-Lösung zur Selbstvermarktung unseres Ferienhauses"
良い点: Lodgify umfasst (fast) alles, was ich mir für die Vermarktung gewünscht habe. Es vereint den Website-Baukasten, es administriert die Website-Domain, es bietet umfassende Möglichkeiten zur Verwaltung und Abrechnung von Ferienimmobilien. Ich selbst verwalte damit nur 1 Haus, allerdings lassen sich auch problemlos mehrere Immobilien anbinden. Super einfach ist auch das Erstellen mehrsprachiger Webseiten. Auch hier gibt es noch etwas Luft nach oben, indem man z.B. die Inhalte der Webseiten auch per Auswahl übersetzen ließe. Habe ich über die STandard-Objektseien hinaus eigene Webseiten entworfen, so muß ich diese derzeit mit einem externen Übersetzungsprogramm übersetzen und in der Zielsprache per drag & drop einfügen. Die Seitenstruktur wird aber in allen Sprachen übernommen und auch die Seitentitel werden automatisch übersetzt. Das Übersetzen im Programm geht bislang nur bei den Standard-Seiten, die die unmittelbare Objektverwaltung administrieren.
改善点: Insgesamt bin ich sehr zufrieden mit meiner Entscheidung für Lodgify! Ich sehe in wenigen Punkten Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten, z.B.: - die Seite zur Emailkommunikation mit den Gästen könnte übersichtlicher sein - ich würde mir wünschen, dass der Professional-Zugang schon die Gäste-App enthält. Ich bin mir noch unsicher, ob sich der Aufpreis für die Ultimate-Version für mich lohnt - die Kalender-Darstellung könnte farbiger oder prägnanter schwarz-weiß-grau sein, insgesamt ist Webseite "Verfügbarkeit" ausbaubar. So wäre es schick, wenn man gleich von dort ausgehend einen Zeitraum markieren und für eine Buchungsanfrage aussuchen könnte - die Cookie-Policy im Webseite-Baukasten bedürfte eines Updates, so daß man zwischen notwendigen Cookies und Komfort-Cookies wählen kann. Wishlist: - 360°-Rundgänge in Verbindung mit Grundrissen anwenderfreundlich als widget im Baukasten integrieren (ich weiß es gibt schon Möglichkeiten z.B. über google)

タイトル: Easy to use but has major flaws
投稿者: Emilie カナダのOwner ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Easy to use but has major flaws"
良い点: The software is easy to use. I had an onboarding session which was very helpful and informative. A+ on that. I really like how one software is able to manage different platforms.
改善点: Guest communication is the most annoying flaw of this software. I chose Lodgify mostly for the option to automate communications with my guests. I've been using it under a month and I'm already going back to Airbnb to send my emails as their software is better, at least for my needs. With Lodgify, I've had multiple issues (emails not sent in correct sequence, emails in wrong language, test email sent to guest, no option to use only guest's first name as a placeholder...) which really doesn't look good on me as a host, on top of other things such as my cleaning team having to create different email addresses for the different properties they provide service to when owners are different... IT support is reactive but limited in that they do not provide suitable solutions. For example, I am told to send bilingual emails to avoid the language issue (not acceptable as this is VERY impersonal - contrary to what I want to achieve), test email sent to guest issue unresolved after a few weeks, no capability to send emails at a certain time of day to avoid the wrong sequence issue... I am considering cancelling my subscription as this is causing me more work, headache and embarrassment... Not good.

良い点: Lodgify meets my needs for managing 14 properties for an affordable price (about $340 per month). It is reliable in syncing calendars to prevent double bookings, and managing pricing and fees. It has a slick feature where you can flip between all your properties to make one change on a particular page (pricing for example). It's pretty user friendly for basic property management functions. The dashboard is a great feature and the automated responses are great. It also works well for managing direct bookings as well as platform bookings all in one place. Customer support is responsive and effective for getting quick help for basic platform management and functions. The website builder is basic but effective. I am hoping they will improve their design features moving forward, but I have noticed that Lodgify is regularly making improvements to many of their features, and that is appreciated very much! It is highly defintely effective for the day to day management of your properties.
改善点: Three things: Starting up as a new customer was extremely slow, time-consuming, and frustrating. Primarily because their training material is not written in a simple, straight-forward sequential process with steps. Rather, it is organized as a list of topics so you have to scour over pages of info to find what you are looking for. Second thing: Onboarding new rentals takes about a week per rental, and I am very computer savvy. Customer support tries, and they are nice, however, there are no manuals or directions geared for onboarding new properties on all the main platforms easily, and there is no live phone support for connectivity. Live support for simple issues is great, but anything related to connecting new rentals requires email communication and waiting. Their connectivity team tries to respond in writing within 24 hours and often the issues are complex. They also respond in the middle of the night and if you are unable to fix things with their guidance, you won't hear back until the following night. Most recently it took me 4 weeks to resolve payment issues for 5 of my rentals, which resulted in massive cancellations. They never did send me instructions in writing. I understand the complexity because Booking.com, Airbnb, VRBO, etc., all have different policies that impact connectivity and they change over time as well.
